overview_description.description:
Bus.com is a travel agency focused on selling bus travel tickets for major bus operators in Nigeria. It provides its customers with the convenience of pre-booking bus travel tickets through the internet and telephones to travel across Nigerian cities.

Bus.com’s mission is to make traveling easier for commuters; drive more customers to bus operators; and improve bus transportation services in Nigeria.

Bus.com is based in Lagos, Nigeria.
